headline: 14 Michigan deals, $127.4M raised — led by Tiseo Holdings, LLC

top_deals.summary: Tiseo Holdings, LLC, a Troy-based construction company, filed a $48.5M equity offering under Rule 506(b); $48.5M sold to 7 investors.
TPlus3 Qualified Fund LP, a Farmington Hills-based hedge fund, disclosed an open-ended (indefinite) raise; $28.1M sold to 4 investors. (Amended filing.)
Tiseo Acquisition, LLC, a Troy-based construction company, filed a $23.5M equity offering under Rule 506(b); $23.5M sold to 22 investors.

top_deals.company: Draper Goren Blockchain Early-Stage Opportunity Fund, L.P.
top_deals.summary: Draper Goren Blockchain Early-Stage Opportunity Fund, L.P., a Troy-based investment company, filed a $20M equity offering under Rule 506(b); $4.2M sold to 8 investors.
Trillium 440GR Owner, LLC, a Grand Rapids-based commercial real estate company, filed an indefinite-size equity offering under Rule 506(b); $16M sold to 87 investors.

new_funds.summary: TPlus3 Qualified Fund LP, a Farmington Hills-based hedge fund, disclosed an open-ended (indefinite) raise; $28.1M sold to 4 investors. (Amended filing.)

new_funds.company: PCT Co Invest Fund Limited Partnership
new_funds.summary: PCT Co Invest Fund Limited Partnership, a Birmingham-based private equity fund, disclosed an open-ended (indefinite) raise; $3M sold to 3 investors.

notable_ma.summary: Decidr U.S. Inc., a Bloomfield Hills-based company, filed a Form D tied to a business combination (acquisition or merger); $9.4M of equity issued to 39 investors.
Terence E. Adderley Revocable Trust K and others reported a 93.5% stake in Kelly Services Inc (KELYA) (Schedule 13D/A amendment 3).

material_agreements.summary: ITC Holdings Corp. entered into a material definitive agreement (equity financing).
Kelly Services Inc (KELYA) entered into a material definitive agreement.

talking_points.text: Michigan issuers reported $127.4M sold across 10 Form D filings this week, up 18% vs. the prior 4-week average. The largest was Tiseo Holdings, LLC (Troy, Construction) targeting $48.5M. Good question to ask: are founders in real estate favoring equity rounds over venture debt right now?
Decidr U.S. Inc. disclosed a deal. Use it to ask how buyers are valuing Michigan other assets and whether consolidation is accelerating.

2 Michigan-based pooled funds filed Form Ds, reporting $31.1M raised so far — led by TPlus3 Qualified Fund LP (Hedge Fund). A natural opener: what are LPs asking Michigan sponsors for in today's fundraising market?
